title: Personal Credit Cards: purchase APR range and cash advance APR by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: purchase and cash advance APRs

This rate card covers the Personal Credit Cards line. For every card tier it gives the lowest and the highest purchase APR that can be assigned at approval, and the APR that applies to cash advances.

## Rate table

| Card tier | Lowest purchase APR at approval | Highest purchase APR at approval | Cash advance APR |
|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 26.49% | 26.49% | 29.49% |
| College Rewards Visa | 21.49% | 28.49% | 29.49% |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 15.24% | 24.24% | 28.99% |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 19.24% | 28.24% | 29.49% |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 20.24% | 28.24% | 29.49% |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 18.24% | 25.24% | 27.49% |

## What the columns mean

- **Lowest and highest purchase APR**: the range within which a purchase APR is assigned when the card is approved.
- **Cash advance APR**: the APR charged on cash advances on the tier.

## Equivalent reading

- On Secured Visa the lowest and highest purchase APR are the same figure, so every Secured Visa is assigned a purchase APR of 26.49%.
- Platinum Low Rate Visa has the lowest purchase APR floor of the line, 15.24%.
- The cash advance APR is a single tier figure rather than a range.

## Basis Q&A (hypothetical figures)

**Q: Could a Cash Rewards Visa be approved at a hypothetical purchase APR of 29.24%?**
A: No. The highest purchase APR assigned on that tier is 28.24%.

**Q: Could a Platinum Low Rate Visa be approved at a hypothetical purchase APR of 16.00%?**
A: Yes, 16.00% lies between the tier's lowest figure of 15.24% and highest figure of 24.24%.
